hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts annual stock-based compensation burden falling versus revenue, with positive revenue/gross-profit context and liquid SPY-relative leadership, may identify growth-quality candidates whose shareholder dilution cost is improving before a 10-trading-day continuation leg.

prediction.confidence_reason: SBC burden improvement is a distinct shareholder-dilution quality field versus recent R&D, SG&A, tax, interest, and buyback scouts; however raw Companyfacts alpha has been saturated and likely fails on window or comparator robustness.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual SBC, revenue, or gross-profit facts, missing prior comparison period, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC tag mapping, filed-date PIT SBC/revenue improvement gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SBC burden-improvement source cleared the numeric three-window replay screen, but remains only a replay lead because no shared daily/backtest helper was promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.9438; aggregate PnL delta $+15,748.19; max drawdown drift +0.0048; 108 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping SBC tag lists, SBC/revenue thresholds, revenue or gross-profit floors, annual fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT dilution-quality evidence such as per-share SBC burden net of buybacks, grant-value normalization, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep SBC tags, ratio thresholds, annual fact freshness, price guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
